script: For most beginner skills, this is not true. A mobile phone can do the research, the learning, the designs in Canva, the short video edits in CapCut and the messages to clients. If you share a family phone, agree on a time when you can use it for work, and keep your work apps in one folder. If your internet is weak, download your lessons when you have a good connection, and watch them later. Your time is also a resource. Write down the hours in your week when you are free, even if they are short. Then choose the skill that fits those hours, not the skill that sounds most impressive. Here is the most important rule in this course. Never share your one-time code, which we call an OTP, your PIN or your password with anyone. This is true even if someone says they are from a company, a bank or a platform. Real staff never ask for these. Ask for work through the platform, or through a shared Google Drive link that you trust.
